title: 第16章 同去白杨镇，陷身白龙峡
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
现场一片惨烈。

    陆林强忍着恶心，将所有木箭收回。

    翻过三人尸身，确认没有半分自己留下的痕迹，这才背着冬鹿离开。

    陆方和孙志刚身上还有些银两。

    狼群自然不会带走。

    陆林也不能眼馋。

    回到家中。

    将冬鹿挂在柴房，陆林这才进屋。

    这时，梁心兰敲了敲门。

    陆林下床，就见梁心兰端着一盆热水站在门口。

    “嫂嫂，你这是……”

    “小叔辛苦一天，洗洗脚早些休息吧。”

    “这……”

    陆林有心拒绝，梁心兰却直接进来。

    无奈之下，陆林只能说自己来洗。

    “小叔这是嫌弃奴家了？”

    梁心兰抬着头，仰望陆林，“奴家每日在家中，有吃有喝，却劳烦小叔进山与野兽搏斗，游走在生死边缘。”

    “奴家做不得其他，帮小叔洗个脚，祛除身上的疲惫，难道……小叔真的不要奴家做点事？”

    这一天，梁心兰在家里想了许多。

    她所说也并非谎言。

    尤其是今晚陆林归来，风尘仆仆，背着两头几百斤的冬鹿，梁心兰更感觉自己对家里没用。

    眼见梁心兰执意如此，陆林只能作罢。

    “那就麻烦嫂嫂了。”

    “不麻烦，小叔每日练箭，进山狩猎才辛苦。”

    脱去陆林的鞋袜，将双脚置于盆中。

    那一双雪白的小手，搓揉着陆林的大脚。

    这几日陆林跑的路不少，鞋也不甚合脚，导致脚上出了七八个水泡。

    梁心兰揉捏在手中，疼在心里。

    给陆林双脚擦干，梁心兰又拿来银针，将脚上血泡挑破，挤出血水，敷了些药粉。

    又拿了一双干净的袜子给陆林穿上。

    “小叔夜里不要脱袜，明日就能好个差不多。”

    梁心兰端起脚盆，起身欲走。

    “多谢嫂嫂了。”

    陆林穿上鞋，“对了，嫂嫂，明天就是腊月二十，我准备跟孙友成一起，去趟镇上，把那头大的冬鹿卖掉换成银钱。”

    “你把那头小鹿的鹿肉处理一下，给大勇叔和桂花婶子送去些。”

    “奴家知道了，小叔明日小心。”
content_en:
The scene was tragic.

Lu Lin suppressed his nausea and took back all the wooden arrows.

After turning over the bodies of the three people and confirming that there were no traces of himself, he left with Donglu on his back.

Lu Fang and Sun Zhigang still have some money on them.

Of course the wolves won't take it away.

Lu Lin can't be greedy either.

Return home.

After hanging the winter deer in the woodshed, Lu Lin entered the house.

At this time, Liang Xinlan knocked on the door.

Lu Lin got out of bed and saw Liang Xinlan standing at the door holding a basin of hot water.

"Sister-in-law, what are you..."

"Uncle, it's been a hard day, wash your feet and rest early."

"This..."

Lu Lin deliberately refused, but Liang Xinlan came in directly.

In desperation, Lu Lin could only say that he would wash it himself.

"Uncle, do you dislike the slave family?"

Liang Xinlan raised her head and looked up at Lu Lin, "The slave family is at home every day, eating and drinking, but bothering my uncle to go into the mountains to fight with wild beasts, wandering on the edge of life and death."

"The slave family can't do anything else, just wash my uncle's feet and get rid of the fatigue on his body. Could it be that...my uncle really doesn't want the slave family to do something?"

On this day, Liang Xinlan thought a lot at home.

What she said was not a lie.

Especially when Lu Lin returned tonight, covered in dust and carrying two winter deer weighing several hundred kilograms, Liang Xinlan felt even more useless to the family.

Seeing that Liang Xinlan insisted on doing this, Lu Lin could only give up.

"Then I'll trouble my sister-in-law."

"It's not troublesome. My uncle practices archery every day, and hunting in the mountains is hard work."

He took off Lu Lin's shoes and socks and placed his feet in the basin.

Those little snow-white hands rubbed Lu Lin's big feet.

Lu Lin had been running a lot these days, and his shoes didn't fit well, resulting in seven or eight blisters on his feet.

Liang Xinlan kneaded it in her hands, feeling pain in her heart.

After drying Lu Lin's feet, Liang Xinlan took a silver needle and popped the blood blisters on her feet, squeezed out the blood, and applied some medicinal powder.

He took another pair of clean socks and put them on Lu Lin.

"Uncle, don't take off your socks at night, and you'll be almost fine tomorrow."

Liang Xinlan picked up the footbath and stood up to leave.

"Thank you, sister-in-law."

Lu Lin put on his shoes, "By the way, sister-in-law, tomorrow is the twentieth day of the twelfth lunar month. I'm going to go to town with Sun Youcheng to sell that big winter deer for money."

"You process the deer's meat and send some to Uncle Dayong and Aunt Guihua."

"The slave family knows, uncle, be careful tomorrow."
